[[Norm MacLean]] - stepbrother |TV actor = }} '''Chet Jr.''' is the child of [[Steph Harper]] and [[Bert (TV series)|Bert]], residing in [[Vault 33]] and later [[Vault 32]] {{In|FOTV}}. ==Background== Chet Jr. was born soon after his mother went into labor when [[Norm MacLean|Norm]] visited [[Chet (TV series)|Chet]] in his room. He has since been raised primarily by Chet. He did not receive his name until after Steph, Chet, and others moved into Vault 32; as Chet had been taking care of him for Steph, others began calling the baby "Chet Jr." even though his parents had not named him, and Steph readily accepted that as the child's name when Chet informed her of it in order to get him off her back. Chet is not comfortable with the name, as it was also his father's name and he finds it personal.{{FOTV|2|1}} ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===Season 1=== ====[[The Past]]==== Laying in his cradle, the child coos as Chet waves a raddle in front of him. Afterward, the child is seen being carried by his mother, who sits in a wheelchair, as Chet pushes them along as they tour around [[Vault 32]]. ====[[The Radio]]==== [[File:Steph with child.png|thumb|Steph with her child]] The child is seen being held by Chet as he prepares their baby bottle when he and Steph get a notification that they're being transferred to Vault 32. When Norm visits Chet's room, Steph holding her child, answers the door. She briefly talks to Norm, and when Chet approaches, she advises him not to take too long as they have to pack. Their conversation is cut short when Steph calls for Chet's attention. By the time the former Vault 33 residents who were chosen to live in Vault 32 are seen off by some of the Vault 33 residents, Betty gives a farewell speech to them all. Chet is seen holding the child, as their mother is assigned to be the new overseer of Vault 32. Once the speech is over, Chet, while holding the child, followed the other new Vault 32 residents into their new home Vault. ===Season 2=== ====[[The Innovator]]==== Now in [[Vault 32]], Chet is taking care of Steph's baby while she is in a meeting with [[Davey (TV series)|Davey]]. Once the meeting is finished, Chet brings him in to Steph's Overseer office to discuss his potential job, but Steph keeps him on baby care duty. Chet brings up that the baby has still yet to be named and that the neighbors are calling him "Chet Jr." now, which Steph thinks works. Chet tries to protest against this, as "[[Chet Jr. (mentioned)|Chet Jr.]]" was what his late father went by and brings up memories of his death by starvation. However, Steph ends the conversation. ==Notes== Steph's child was first named Chet Jr. in the first episode of [[Fallout TV series season 2|season 2]], "[[The Innovator]]." Prior to this, Steph had not chosen a name for him. ==Appearances== Chet Jr. appears only {{in|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances |5=105 |7=107 |9=201 |12=204 |14=206 |15=207 }} ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]] [[Category:Vault 32 characters]] [[Category:Vault 33 characters]]
